tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists the Resumeily resume templates with their id, name, description and layout. The template ids are the accepted values of the `template` field.

tools.name: create_resume
tools.description: Creates a temporary resume draft on Resumeily from structured resume content. Returns a preview of the first page, a private draft_token that identifies the draft, and an 'Open & Save on Resumeily' link where the resume can be saved to a Resumeily account.

tools.name: update_resume
tools.description: Edits a temporary resume draft identified by its draft_token; resumes already saved in a Resumeily account are never affected. tools.name: preview_resume
tools.description: Returns an image of the first page of the resume draft (rendered exactly like the final PDF) plus the preview and 'Open & Save on Resumeily' links.

tools.name: get_import_link
tools.description: Returns the link where the user saves the resume draft to their Resumeily account (sign-up or login), edits it and downloads the PDF.
